name: io.skaphos/repokeeper
description: Inventory, drift reporting and sync planning for a multi-repo Git workspace. Read and write tools.

runtimeArguments.name: -i
runtimeArguments.description: Keep stdin open. The server speaks MCP over stdio, so the container must not detach.

runtimeArguments.name: --rm
runtimeArguments.description: Remove the container on exit. The server holds no state of its own; the workspace on the host is the state.

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Bind-mount the workspace at its IDENTICAL host path, read-only by default -- for example /home/me/work/skaphos:/home/me/work/skaphos:ro. RepoKeeper's registry records absolute host paths, so a mount at any other path makes every entry miss and the inventory reports every repository as missing. There is no path remapping. Drop the :ro suffix to enable the write tools, and add --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" so files are created with your ownership.

packageArguments.description: Start the MCP server over stdio.

packageArguments.name: --config
packageArguments.description: Absolute path to the workspace's .repokeeper.yaml, inside the mount and therefore identical to its host path. Required: one configured server entry serves exactly one workspace root. The CLI finds its registry by walking upward from the working directory, which lets several purpose-specific roots self-select by position, but a container's working directory is fixed before any tool call and cannot reproduce that. Configure one entry per workspace root; for a position-sensitive multi-root workflow, use the native binary instead.
